about: Bundles (plans/22-bundles.md, D-39): sets of questions chosen before a session. `languages`: the locales a bundle is offered in; the game offers only its language's bundles (D-85). `kind: base`: a base bundle, exactly one per session; players switch the other bundles on or off. `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, capitals): required on `kind: region`, only there; the game shows its flag as the bundle's icon. `icon` (optional, not on `kind: region`): the tile's symbol, one of book, pin, puzzle, flask, ball, scroll, reel, globe, film, heart, mic, headphones (BUNDLE_ICONS in app/client/src/engine/pool.ts); missing → pin. Every question is in exactly one bundle (`bundle`, default base). Bundles add questions and don't own a topic. `rule` (English) is how the pipeline decides membership, `voice` (English) the language variety of its own text in prompts (D-78): a regional bundle's drafts, in its first `languages` entry; base's es text. `name` and `description` are for the game, in Spanish (es, es-ES); en and de in names.<locale>.json.

bundles.name: Paquete básico
bundles.description: Preguntas de todo un poco, para jugar en cualquier parte.
bundles.rule: Everything that isn't in another bundle: answerable by families anywhere in the world, whatever their language; well-known facts about any country belong here (Colombia's capital, Japan's flag, Italian pasta, García Márquez), knowledge only one country's or one language's players have doesn't.
bundles.voice: idiomatic Latin American Spanish (es-419): words a family anywhere in Latin America uses; Spain has its own es-ES text

bundles.name: Regional: Colombia
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con Colombia: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Colombia: Colombian places, food, customs, festivals, people, music, sport, words, sayings or history that the players outside Colombia mostly wouldn't know.
bundles.voice: Spanish with Colombian usage: "bombillo", "carro", "celular", "gripa", "crispetas", "arquero", "tinto" (black coffee), "parcero" only in jokes

bundles.name: Regional: Estados Unidos
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con Estados Unidos: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música, deporte y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to the United States: American places, food, customs, holidays, people, music, sport, media, words, sayings or history that players outside the US mostly wouldn't know; topics shared across the English-speaking world, and British-only ones (those belong to `uk`), are not here.
bundles.voice: American English: US spelling ("color", "gray"), US words ("soccer", "cookie", "truck", "vacation", "sidewalk"), dates as "July 20, 1969", imperial units with metric in brackets only where it helps

bundles.name: Regional: Alemania
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con Alemania: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música, deporte y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Germany: German places, food, customs, holidays, people, music, sport, media, words, sayings or history that players outside Germany mostly wouldn't know; things known to families anywhere (Berlin's wall, Beethoven, Oktoberfest as a fact) stay in `base`, and Austrian or Swiss topics are not here.
bundles.voice: Standard German as spoken in Germany: German spelling with "ß", German words ("Brötchen", "Handy", "Fahrrad", "Bürgersteig"), dates as "20. Juli 1969", metric units

bundles.name: Regional: Reino Unido
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con el Reino Unido: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música, deporte y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to the United Kingdom: British places, food, customs, holidays, people, music, sport, media, words, sayings or history that players outside the UK mostly wouldn't know; topics shared across the English-speaking world, and American-only ones (those belong to `usa`), are not here.
bundles.voice: British English: UK spelling ("colour", "grey", "realise"), UK words ("football", "biscuit", "lorry", "holiday", "pavement"), dates as "20 July 1969", metric units with miles and pints where Britons use them

bundles.name: Regional: España
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con España: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música, deporte y palabras de aquí.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Spain: Spanish places, food, customs, fiestas, people, music, sport, media, words, sayings or history that players outside Spain mostly wouldn't know; things families anywhere know (Madrid as a capital, Don Quixote, paella as a dish) stay in `base`, and the topics of Latin American regions (`colombia`, `mexico`) are not here.
bundles.voice: Spanish as spoken in Spain (es-ES): peninsular words ("ordenador", "móvil", "coche", "zumo", "patata", "vale"), "vosotros" forms, dates as "20 de julio de 1969", metric units

bundles.name: Regional: México
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con México: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música, deporte y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Mexico: Mexican places, food, customs, fiestas, people, music, sport, media, words, sayings or history that players outside Mexico mostly wouldn't know; things families anywhere know (Mexico City as a capital, tacos as a dish) stay in `base`, and the topics of other Latin American regions (`colombia`) and of Spain (`spain`) are not here.
bundles.voice: Mexican Spanish: "computadora", "celular", "carro", "camión" (bus), "platicar", "chamarra", "padre" (cool), "ahorita", "ustedes" (no vosotros), dates as "20 de julio de 1969", metric units

bundles.name: Paquete de preguntas de ciencia
bundles.description: Más preguntas sobre naturaleza, espacio, inventos, ingeniería y matemáticas.
bundles.rule: More and deeper questions on natural sciences, technology, engineering and maths: living things, the human body, physics, chemistry, space, geology, weather and ecology, inventions and machines, numbers and shapes, and their history (scientists, inventions, the space race) at every difficulty, from kids to adults, answerable by families anywhere in the world whatever their language; fan-level detail is welcome, while the famous core base already asks stays in `base`, and things only one country's players know stay in that country's regional bundle (`usa`, `spain`, …); present-day places, maps and climate zones are `geography`'s, sport `sports`', film and TV `movies`', history outside science `history`'s

bundles.name: Paquete de preguntas de deportes
bundles.description: Más preguntas sobre deportes: deportistas, competiciones, equipos, récords.
bundles.rule: More and deeper questions on sport: football and every other sport, clubs, leagues, competitions, legendary players, records and rules, the Olympics and World Cups, and the history of each sport at every difficulty, from kids to adults, answerable by families anywhere in the world whatever their language; fan-level detail is welcome, while the famous core base already asks stays in `base`, and things only one country's players know stay in that country's regional bundle (`usa`, `spain`, …); films about sport are `movies`', the science of the body `stem`'s

bundles.name: Paquete de preguntas de historia
bundles.description: Más preguntas sobre historia: épocas, imperios, personajes y sucesos de todo el mundo.
bundles.rule: More and deeper questions on history: eras, civilisations, empires, rulers, wars, revolutions, explorers and everyday life in the past, historical borders and old place names, with every region of the world in balance at every difficulty, from kids to adults, answerable by families anywhere in the world whatever their language; fan-level detail is welcome, while the famous core base already asks stays in `base`, and things only one country's players know stay in that country's regional bundle (`usa`, `spain`, …); the history of science, inventions and the space race is `stem`'s, of a sport, the Olympics and World Cups `sports`', of film and TV `movies`', present-day places `geography`'s

bundles.name: Paquete de preguntas de cine y series
bundles.description: Más preguntas sobre cine y series: sus películas y series favoritas, personajes e historias.
bundles.rule: More and deeper questions on film and TV series: films and series of every era and country, live action and animation, genres, directors, actors, characters, quotes, soundtracks, awards and screen history at every difficulty, from kids to adults, answerable by families anywhere in the world whatever their language; fan-level detail is welcome, while the famous core base already asks stays in `base`, and things only one country's players know stay in that country's regional bundle (`usa`, `spain`, …); reality TV and news stay in `base`

bundles.name: Paquete de preguntas de geografía
bundles.description: Más preguntas de geografía: países, ciudades, mapas, banderas, montañas, ríos y mares.
bundles.rule: More and deeper questions on present-day geography: countries, regions, cities and capitals, flags, maps and borders, mountains, rivers, lakes, seas, islands, deserts, climate zones and populations at every difficulty, from kids to adults, answerable by families anywhere in the world whatever their language; fan-level detail is welcome, while the famous core base already asks stays in `base`, and things only one country's players know stay in that country's regional bundle (`usa`, `spain`, …); geology, weather physics and ecology are `stem`'s, historical borders, empires and old place names `history`'s
